data.name: Halverson
data.long_meaning: The name Halverson originated from Old Norse 'halfr' meaning 'half' and 'son' meaning 'son' or 'descendant'. Halverson was a common Scandinavian name for those who held a position of power or authority, symbolizing the idea of being a ruler over a community or territory. In Christian context, this name can be interpreted as a 'Son of the Half-God' or 'Half-Divine' Son.
